# Pizza Backend Skill

## Apply this skill when

- adding or changing Express routes
- modeling MongoDB documents
- implementing authentication or authorization
- changing inventory or order logic
- integrating Razorpay or email
- creating scheduled jobs

## Rules

- Put validation in Zod schemas.
- Use controller/service separation.
- Use transactions or atomic updates for stock and payment state.
- Add authentication and role middleware on admin routes.
- Verify Razorpay signatures and webhook signatures server-side.
- Use typed request/response helpers.
- Never expose secret values or password reset tokens.
